turns.text: Hi, I'm Owen's teacher. Thanks for coming in.
Who decided on the zero, and did anyone talk to Owen first?
Thanks for coming in, Ms. Kalinowski. I know your schedule is brutal.
My schedule isn't why I'm here. Was Owen heard before that zero went in?
I have to say, you're far more reasonable than I expected. Most parents come in swinging.
Save it. Twice now you haven't answered me, so what do you actually have?
It's refreshing. You clearly see the whole picture, so I think we're really on the same side here.
"Same side." My son got a zero on his phone in the middle of class, so show me a document or I'm going to the principal.
